safe_state.switch: hold Hermes gateway configuration and service state unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not restart, stop, or reconfigure a gateway automatically; use the human-approved Hermes status interface to diagnose an unavailable gateway.

sampling.what: Daily Hermes gateway status result for the currently configured profile; do not include environment variables, credentials, or profile-specific private details.
sampling.working_well: The gateway process is alive, runtime state is running, and every reported platform is connected.
